A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 32-page versions of Graph Persistence goes Spectral, with matching research identity and Appendices A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: Section 6 reports original synthetic graph-discrimination and real-data prediction experiments. Appendix F reports spectral ablations, GPS experiments, and empirical stability validation.

after.justification: The original empirical studies are retained, with corrected synthetic benchmark and ablation results in Tables 2 and 5.

M1.justification: SpectRe's definition, spectral components, GNN integration, and fast approximations are unchanged. The reported curvature correction concerns implementation of the retained synthetic evaluation filters.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Cayley and BREC benchmarks and nine real-data datasets. Appendix F retains the same dataset coverage for spectral ablations, GPS predictions, and stability examples.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 3, 5, and 6. PH0, PH1, RePHINE, LS, partial-spectrum SpectRe, and the GCN/GPS comparisons remain in their corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Appendix E explicitly reports correcting the augmented Forman–Ricci curvature computation and recomputing results, establishing a limited correction to implemented edge-filtration preprocessing. The stated curvature formula, splits, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and spectrum-selection settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing spectral ablation in Appendix F receives corrected evidence: partial-spectrum SpectRe now falls short of the full version on CFI and Distance while retaining equality on Basic, Regular, and Extension. The questions tested remain the same; stability validation and the graph case study are unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 6.2 retains means and standard deviations over three independent runs. No changed run counts, seed information, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation practices are reported; recomputation alone does not establish such changes.

E6.justification: Following the reported bug correction, Table 2 revises SpectRe's CFI accuracy from 0.77 to 0.04 and overall BREC accuracy from 0.72 to 0.54. PH1/RePHINE overall scores change from 0.48/0.53 to 0.41/0.41. Table 5 changes LS's CFI score from 0.72 to 0.04 and partial SpectRe's CFI/Distance scores from 0.77/0.05 to 0.03/0.00. These substantially alter empirical comparisons. Tables 3, 6, and 7 retain their results.

T1.justification: Formal definitions, assumptions, expressivity and stability results, and proofs remain unchanged, including Appendices A–D. Appendix D.3 substitutes gamma for rho in one explanatory sentence, an inconsistent reference to the unchanged Definition 3.1 rather than a revised mathematical construction.

C1.justification: The abstract narrows the claim of greater expressivity than 'existing descriptors on graphs' to 'PH and spectral information on graphs alone.' The introduction and conclusion retain the principal method, expressivity, stability, and empirical-effectiveness contributions.

C2.justification: Section 6.1 removes the interpretation of an empirical PH1–RePHINE expressivity gap on Extension and CFI. Appendix F replaces SpectRe's empirical advantage over LS with parity attributed to the chosen filtrations and qualifies partial-spectrum equivalence. Stability interpretations and computational limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix E adds disclosure of the curvature implementation error, correction, and recomputation, referring readers to the official repository for further details. It removes the additional anonymous repository link and anonymity wording. The existing official code link, V100 hardware disclosure, and hyperparameters remain.

R1.justification: The abstract limits comparative positioning to PH and spectral information alone instead of broadly referring to existing graph descriptors. This is a limited scope refinement; all 67 references and the detailed positioning relative to RePHINE and persistent-Laplacian work are unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized edits revise the abstract and synthetic-result discussions, add an implementation note, and remove obsolete anonymization wording. Appendix D.3 also introduces an isolated parameter-name inconsistency. The overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains a correction notice, and Table 5 revises its caption and replaces colored highlighting with bold best/tied scores. The implementation note shifts Appendix F content, and the stability discussion is regrouped around Table 7. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Disclosing the curvature error, replacing affected results, and revising the empirical LS comparison and partial-spectrum claims improve transparency and consistency with the reported evidence. The abstract is also more precise. The improvement is limited by the correction note's description of changes as small and qualitatively unchanged, despite SpectRe's CFI accuracy changing from 0.77 to 0.04 and several comparative conclusions changing.
